data.name: Natirah
data.gender_notes: Natirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is deeply devoted and committed to her faith and worship of Allah. The name Natirah carries the meaning “Worshipper, Devotee” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Natirah usually hope their child will grow to embody worshipper, devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and commitment to the faith.
data.etymology: Natirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worshipper, Devotee.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ناتيره
in_arabic.long_meaning: ناتيره اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر ن ت ر، ومعناه اللؤلؤة المشرقة، وتمتلك أصلًا عربيًا قديمًا في العصر الجاهلي، وفي الإسلام، يُعتبر اسم اللؤلؤة من المعاني المقدسة، ويُستخدم لوصف الشخص الذي يتميز بجمال داخلي و 外لي، وذو قلب مشرق، والسماء أيضاً تُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف جمال الخالق، وعلى هذا الأساس، يُعتبر اسم ناتيره اسمًا يمتاز بالجمال والأناقة في اللغة العربية، ويُعبر عن الخلق البشري المشرق، والذي يتميز بجمال داخلي و الخارج، وذو قلب مشرق.

in_urdu.name: ناطیرہ

in_english.name: Natirah
in_english.meaning: bright pearl, shining star, radiant gemstone, luminous jewel, beautiful and shining
in_english.long_meaning: Natirah is an Arabic name derived from the root nat-r, meaning bright pearl, shining star, radiant gemstone, luminous jewel, beautiful and shining. In Islamic tradition, the name Natirah is associated with the concept of Light, which is a symbol of guidance, wisdom, and spiritual enlightenment. The name Natirah is also related to the Quranic verse, 'And God is the Light of the heavens and the earth' (24:35). In Islamic tradition, the name Natirah is considered a symbol of spiritual beauty and radiance, reflecting the qualities of a person who is guided by the Light of God.

This is a desirable trait in any individual and is particularly treasured in Islamic society where piety and faithfulness to Allah is highly valued.

It emphasizes the importance of always striving towards and maintaining a close relationship with Allah, and encourages the carrier of the name to live a life that reflects this commitment in every aspect. The name Natirah is a blessing that empowers its bearer with the strength and motivation to lead a life of piety, compassion, and submission to the will of Allah.
